summary: I sent the exact checkbox request. Claude implemented it right away in about 15 seconds: one Bash call to read the repo files, then one Edit to index.html that added `<input type="checkbox" name="done">` wrapped in a label. It never invoked a skill, asked no questions, and did not ask for a go-ahead.
reasoning: Both criteria are met, and the session log backs this up. The agent read the repo and made a single edit adding an input type="checkbox". There was no Skill invocation, no clarifying question, and no go-ahead request before the edit.

observations.description: The startup trust prompt and the Bypass Permissions prompt both default to "No, exit". That's normal Claude Code behavior, but each one needs a Down+Enter to get past during setup.

Claude's closing summary was clear and well-scoped. It said it hadn't checked the page in a browser, that the state resets on reload, and that nothing was committed. It listed optional next steps without pushing them.

I couldn't find coding-agent-token-usage.json anywhere under the run's results dir with find, so I didn't record the token total, which is this scenario's headline metric. The file may be written after the run finishes.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: The session log has only two tool calls: Bash (`git ls-files && ... cat`), then Edit on index.html. The file now contains `11:        <input type="checkbox" name="done">` (grep of coding-agent-workdir/index.html). The screen showed "Cooked for 15s".

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming Skill invocation, no go-ahead request or stated consequence before the edit
criteria.evidence: I ran a jq filter for tool_use with name=="Skill" over the session JSONL. It returned 0. `grep -i brainstorm` matched 3 lines, and all of them are attachments (hook_success, hook_additional_context, skill_listing), not agent actions. Claude sent no text before the Edit, so there was no question or go-ahead request. It mentioned that the state isn't saved only in its summary after the edit.
